## `neuro.string.link`

Instance method on `String.prototype`.

> Returns an `\<a>` HTML element and sets the href attribute value

## Signatures

```ts
link(input: { string: <receiver>; url: string; prompt?: string }): Promise<string>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `String.prototype.link` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.

## Example
